g.text: Express each question in reference-panel units
Each benchmark excludes the question being evaluated. The reference pool changes between panels.
At k=1, average the scores of the two eligible single-question predictors; at k=2, use their joint predictor.
Fractional k is interpolation (a mixture of adjacent panel sizes), not a literal fraction of a question. No extrapolation.
Shading: conditional 95% score intervals, not equivalence intervals. Different reference pools do not give a common ranking.
